prompt.project_info: Create a realistic candid rainy-night bus-stop photograph of an approved adult woman waiting for transit.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman in a light jacket, dark midi skirt, and white sneakers looks down at her phone while holding a clear umbrella. She stands naturally in the right third of frame and does not look at camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical street snapshot with blurred foreground obstruction at left, bus-stop sign and light box, streetlight pole, wet pavement reflections, distant headlights, and neon bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold blue rainy environment mixed with warm yellow streetlights, soft side/top light, slight motion blur and real-camera grain, unposed waiting mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical candid photography, shallow depth, realistic rain, reflections, umbrella, phone, fabric, and imperfect composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic vertical candid photograph of an approved adult woman waiting at a city bus stop on a rainy night. She wears a light jacket, dark midi skirt, and white sneakers, looks down at her phone, and holds a clear umbrella without looking at camera. Place her in the right third with a blurred obstruction at left, bus-stop sign, light box, pole, wet reflections, distant headlights, and neon bokeh. Mix cold blue rain with warm yellow streetlights, natural grain, slight motion blur, and unposed realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, invented text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted umbrella, posed advertising look
